component.name: nuxeo.labs.webdavdirectedit.lock
component.documentation:
Releases the edit locks Microsoft Office left behind.
When nuxeo.labs.webdavDirectEdit.lockOnOpen.enabled is true, clicking the button locks the document, and Office's own UNLOCK releases it when the file is closed. Two cases never reach that UNLOCK: Office never opened the file (the launch prompt was cancelled, Office is not installed), or Office went away without unlocking (crash, network loss). Every lock taken by this plugin is therefore recorded with a deadline, and this job releases those past it.
It only ever releases a lock the plugin took itself, and only if it is still that very lock: same owner, same creation time. A lock the user set by hand is never touched.
Each record is claimed atomically before it is released, so running the job on several nodes at once, as happens when the Quartz store is not clustered, releases each lock exactly once.
@since 2025.3
